abstract_K2_message.three_color_interpretation: For D_C restricted to colors {1,2,3}, C forbids exactly the event that D_C uses all three colors.

hardness_contract_correction.statement: The local K2 relation alone is not an NP-hard language under unrestricted non-surjective 3-colorings, because a monochromatic coloring satisfies all no-rainbow constraints.
hardness_contract_correction.consequence: Any future hardness-localization must embed the anchoring/surjectivity contract in addition to the hyperedge relation.

direct_embedding_model.variable_survivors: one dynamic survivor x_v per hypergraph vertex
direct_embedding_model.hyperedge_components: one residual Y0 K2 component C_e per 3-uniform hyperedge e, complete exactly to the three corresponding variable survivors
direct_embedding_model.semantic_requirement: No additional survivor-survivor inequality constraint may be introduced unless proved semantically redundant; the literal direct no-rainbow encoding therefore takes the variable survivors stable.

P7_obstruction.target_vertices: Choose one vertex q_i from each K2 component C_{e_i}.
edge_check: Each consecutive survivor-component pair is incident by construction.
Variable survivors are stable in the direct encoding.
q_1 is nonadjacent to x_v3,x_v4 because e1 contains neither v3 nor v4.
q_2 is nonadjacent to x_v1,x_v4 because e2 contains neither v1 nor v4.
q_3 is nonadjacent to x_v1,x_v2 because e3 contains neither v1 nor v2.
P7_obstruction.conclusion: The seven displayed vertices induce P7.
P7_obstruction.source_consequence: A P7-free exact source state cannot directly realize arbitrary 3-uniform no-rainbow incidence systems with this literal one-variable/one-K2-per-hyperedge semantics.

structural_promotion.candidate_law: The survivor-to-residual-component incidence system of a P7-free source state cannot contain the 7-vertex alternating induced path survivor-component-survivor-component-survivor-component-survivor.
structural_promotion.interpretation: At the semantic-message level, P7 already forbids arbitrary hypergraph incidence composition.
structural_promotion.ceiling: This is only an incidence-path obstruction. It does not bound all message languages or prove tractability.
